description: Calm volatility with supportive equity and credit backdrop
primary_metrics: VIX level;VIX change;SPY return;HYG vs LQD relative return
confirmation_logic: VIX calm plus positive equity momentum; no elevated stress blockers
escalation_meaning: Green informational monitoring; low defensive urgency
de_escalation_conditions: Stress indicators improve for N days; fewer yellow/red alerts; VaR and drawdown stable
review_actions: Monitor benchmark alignment; propose risk budget release review only after persistence
not_allowed: Automatic risk-on tilt; strategy switch; execution

description: Elevated or spiking implied volatility without full multi-asset crisis confirmation
confirmation_logic: VIX >= 20 or large 1d VIX change; high_volatility rule per engine policy
escalation_meaning: Yellow watchlist; red high_volatility only when VIX >= 30 is confirmed by VIX spike or equity stress
de_escalation_conditions: VIX falls and stays below 20 for N days; VIX change normalizes; no credit/liquidity red alerts
review_actions: Monitor vol risk budget; flag defensive adjustment candidate; human review required
not_allowed: Automatic hedge execution; claiming crisis over from one calm day

description: Volatility expansion with confirmed equity weakness
confirmation_logic: risk_off policy: VIX stress plus SPY weakness or drawdown
escalation_meaning: Yellow risk-off review; red risk_off only with linked SPY drawdown confirmation. Portfolio VaR/drawdown breaches fire separate hard-limit alerts
de_escalation_conditions: Equity returns stabilize; drawdown stops deepening; VIX declines for N days
review_actions: Propose defensive rotation review; reduce risk budget subject to human approval
not_allowed: Automatic de-risking trades; strategy switch without review

description: High-yield underperformance versus investment grade with vol confirmation
primary_metrics: HYG vs LQD relative return;VIX level;HYG return;LQD return
escalation_meaning: Red credit defense review when confirmed; metric-only stress stays yellow watch
de_escalation_conditions: HYG/LQD relative stabilizes for N days; VIX falling; fewer credit-linked alerts
review_actions: Flag credit defense candidate; propose HY exposure reduction subject to human review
not_allowed: Automatic HY exit; claiming all-clear on one-day spread bounce

description: Severe credit dislocation with high volatility and portfolio stress
primary_metrics: HYG vs LQD relative return;VIX level;portfolio VaR;portfolio drawdown
confirmation_logic: liquidity_hyg_lqd_stress plus vix_stress_liquidity; optional VaR or drawdown breach
escalation_meaning: Red immediate human review; liquidity and risk budget escalation
de_escalation_conditions: Credit and vol improve for N days; VaR ratio below watch; drawdown shallowing
review_actions: Propose liquidity defense and risk budget cut subject to human review; escalate to committee if persistent

description: Inflation-linked and commodity strength with duration pressure
confirmation_logic: inflation_pressure: TIP plus USO or TLT confirmation; severe duration loss elevates review
escalation_meaning: Yellow inflation/rates review via inflation_pressure; portfolio VaR/drawdown breaches are separate hard_limit_red alerts
de_escalation_conditions: TLT stops falling; oil stabilizes; TIP momentum fades; VaR improves
review_actions: Propose rates and inflation hedge review; reduce long-duration exposure candidate
not_allowed: Automatic duration slash; TIP-only rule firing

description: High headline severity with cross-asset stress confirmation
primary_metrics: headline severity;cross-asset confirmation count;GLD return;UUP return
escalation_meaning: Red geopolitical review; headline-only stays news watch
de_escalation_conditions: Headline severity declines; cross-asset count normalizes for N days
review_actions: Pause or switch strategy candidate subject to backtest evidence and human approval
not_allowed: Automatic geopolitical hedge execution; treating headline rumor as confirmed crisis

description: Post-stress improvement window for human-only posture review
primary_metrics: VIX level;VIX change;HYG vs LQD relative return;portfolio VaR;portfolio drawdown
confirmation_logic: Prior red/yellow alerts improving; no new hard breaches for N days
escalation_meaning: Yellow/green review band; not automatic return to risk-on
de_escalation_conditions: Multi-day persistence of calmer vol credit and risk metrics; executive sign-off required
review_actions: Propose risk budget release review; reduce defensive posture subject to human approval; monitor stabilization
not_allowed: Automatic re-risking; buy signals; execution; treating one-day rally as all-clear
